- Rate individual comics privately from half a star to five stars without marking them read.
- Browse MCU Prep by movie or series release, change the order and search by title or character.
- Explore new guides for Brand New Day, She-Hulk, Ms. Marvel, Brave New World, Guardians of the Galaxy and Agatha All Along. Missing provider details stay explicitly identified.
- Read with clearer Read and Done actions, compact controls and easier navigation on phones and long lists.
- Resume unfinished pasted orders without losing their source or unresolved positions.
- Choose clearly named reading-data, history and unfinished-import backups, with truthful recovery outcomes.
- Back up before upgrading. Existing reading data migrates to schema 4 for ratings; older app versions cannot edit the newer data or restore its backups. History and unfinished drafts still require their separate exports.
